purpose: Bridge the 2026 clonal haplotype-resolved Pv11 genome and sBLISS DNA-break evidence into the existing Pv11Gofre recovery gate without conflating entry into anhydrobiosis with post-rehydration recovery.

paper.title: Haplotype-resolved genome of a dry-preservable cell line reveals chromosome evolution and DNA damage

clonal_haplotype_resolved_assembly.claim: A high-quality chromosome-level, haplotype-resolved assembly was generated from a clonal Pv11 line.
clonal_haplotype_resolved_assembly.importance: This removes a known limitation of prior resources that mixed insect and cell-line DNA and creates a better future coordinate system for Pv11 genome-integrity analyses once the assembly and annotation accessions are resolved.

chromosome_4.claim: Chromosome 4 shows markedly elevated heterozygosity and haplotype-specific genes.
chromosome_4.analysis_caveat: Any chromosome-level DSB comparison must normalize for mappability, gene density, expression and haplotype assignment before treating chromosome 4 as biologically exceptional for break burden.

comparative_synteny.claim: Comparative synteny indicates extensive intrachromosomal rearrangement while broad chromosome identity is largely conserved across chironomid subfamily lineages.

sBLISS_dsb_mapping.claim: Genome-wide sBLISS mapping reports that DNA double-strand breaks during trehalose pretreatment preferentially accumulate near highly expressed transcription start sites.
not_yet_resolved: whether post-rehydration sBLISS measurements exist outside the indexed abstract

existing_recovery_axis.source: Yamada et al. 2020, PLOS ONE, DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0230218
existing_recovery_axis.historical_reference_space: Pv_5.2 / prior P. vanderplanki annotation space
existing_recovery_axis.firewall: DRA008948 expression timepoints provide a bridge for expression context, not direct DSB measurements.

bridge_hypotheses.question: Does DSB density around transcription start sites scale with matched Pv11 expression level during trehalose pretreatment?
planned_test: Freeze exact sBLISS condition/timepoint/replicate manifest from the full paper or deposited metadata.
Map sBLISS break positions to the new haplotype-resolved assembly.
Quantify break density in predeclared TSS windows.
Map DRA008948 T0/T12/T24/T36/T48 expression into the new assembly through an explicit gene/orthology/liftover crosswalk.
Stratify genes by expression quantile and test preregistered break-enrichment contrasts.
Report chromosome 4 separately only after mappability/gene-density/expression normalization.

bridge_hypotheses.question: Are trehalose-entry DSBs measurably cleared during R0/R3/R12/R24/R72 before direct cell-cycle restart?
bridge_hypotheses.required_evidence: Public post-rehydration genome-wide DSB measurements or a prospective equivalent with matched reference, replicates and provenance.
bridge_hypotheses.importance: This is the direct bridge needed before entry-stage DNA damage can strengthen the repair-first recovery hypothesis.

reference_migration_gate.rule: Do not silently remap or numerically compare old Pv_5.2-based expression values against the new haplotype assembly.

next_gates.pass: Official full text/supplement or authoritative repository record exposes assembly/annotation and sBLISS identifiers plus condition metadata.
Versioned mapping table with provenance and ambiguity classes is produced.
Preregistered TSS-break enrichment is replayable from deposited sBLISS data and matched public expression data.
Public or prospective R0/R3/R12/R24/R72-equivalent DSB data establish damage persistence/clearance timing.
Direct public first-S-phase/cell-cycle restart measurement; population growth or single DEG remains insufficient.

anti_overclaim_rule: The 2026 paper strengthens the mechanistic map of genome integrity during entry into anhydrobiosis. It does not, on current indexed evidence, demonstrate post-rehydration DSB clearance, repair-first ordering, S-phase restart, or permission to publish any unpublished BrdU observation.
